text: Path of the room-form accounts changed, dated as departures.jsonl line 18 (18 lines; helper d5f_departure2.py), a history correction to line 17's scope: tools/checks/stage_D5.py (lines 439 to 443) refuses any forms/*-account.md without a branches-D5.jsonl line, and such a line must name a branch D4 cut (lines 124 to 127), so forms/room-form-A-account.md would fail every close of D5a-36 to D5a-41. I do not rename the file to escape the check's pattern. The accounts go to out/room-form-<letter>-account.md, their lines to out/room-forms-D5.jsonl; branches-D5.jsonl and forms/ untouched. To be reported to the PI in the final message.

D5a-36: template d5a36_template.md drafted; checked each typed claim against its source before filling, and found seven to correct (a superseding template follows, the draft kept): r/redhotchilipeppers was asked to move as the bigger sub (c0064), not the smaller; the r/clg quote is a neighbour's member (c0067); r/placetardis's speaker is a member, not shown as the organiser; r/FloydVsVoid's rival described from its model only (no album cover; the unrepresentative point is now the size of its record: 205 concepts against the defining median 99, 26 changes against 10), and no gendered pronoun; r/stardewvalley's trade is an offer (c0114) and the prior-claim request was put to one builder (c0036); section 16's falsification names only A04's two datings. The count of members whose lines say terms or a plan hold only where they reach the placers is now a written list, d5a36_reach_rooms.txt, counted by script: 29 unique, all defining members of A (it was 27 in my head).

out/room-form-A-account.md written (10,862 words with the lists the fill script writes; seventeen sections: the stage's thirteen, with the restrict lines, the branches below, the split and the thin and core rooms as sections of their own; template d5a36_template3.md from d5a36_template.md through d5a36_fix.py; filled by d5f_fill.py; two Edits after reading it whole: section 16 no longer says r/FloydVsVoid's rival offered no terms, and the share nearer another centre is about a quarter, 35 of 135, not a third). Checks, read before this line: 70 cited quotes verbatim through cite.py and every r/ name analysed (d5_quote_check.py); 45 uncited quotes found in their sources, how sentences, room models, model files or codes (d5f_quote_check2.py, written this leg); 0 dashes, 0 contractions, 0 'serves as', no gendered pronouns. Form test: a lean of the population and a form in a weak sense (negotiated order in 86.7 per cent of defining members; relations mostly restate A04's and A05's bounds; terms and plans that hold only where they reach the placers in 29 of 135, a reading); shared form explanation unresolved; arrows all not-testable-here (expectations 0.000 to 0.942); split at k 7 does not read (A.2 a candidate subform for D6); 10 branches lean to A, none of F01 to F06 in it.

D5a-36 closing. Checks read before this line: validate.py D5 0 errors, 0 warnings, branches accounted 35 of 35 (d5a36_validate_D5.txt); d4a08_unchanged.py 86 of 87 unchanged, the one changed notes-D5.md, and its first 871 lines hash to the D4a-07 close snap's value, so the change is the appended section only (line 17's scope keeps the branch accounts, branches-D5.jsonl, waterfall, survival, handback, the D4 files and the room-forms files; it does not name notes-D5.md, the stage's place for candidates). No .pause. Next: done.sh D5.

D5a-37 opened: room form B of the six-form cut, 'the work behind the thread: the chat, the scripts and raiding'. Head reconciled with the diary (D5a-36 closed; form A written). The amendments of departures.jsonl lines 17 and 18 cover this leg: the account goes to out/room-form-B-account.md, its line to out/room-forms-D5.jsonl. Rules: the ten of D5a-36 carry unchanged (rule 6 with n the form's members; thin and core rooms weigh less, every share on the defining rooms; element and arrow by op against the 558; every restrict line on an arrow by a defining member read whole and sorted as fails, record, both or neither, the sort written to files before counting; representatives by distance to the centre; the split rule; branches against the form's share of 705; nearest form by centres; themes by d5_themes' rule on defining codes; the canvas not used). One rule added for the PI's question whether the chat, the scripts and raiding stand apart inside B, fixed before any script runs: take the form's three signature columns (from room-forms-D4a08c.jsonl); for each, the defining members that hold it; the pairwise and three-way overlaps against what independence would give at those presences; and how each set falls into the parts of the tree below B. They stand apart if their holders overlap no more than independence gives and the tree's first split sorts them into different parts (each part holding at least two thirds of one set's holders); they are mixed if the holders overlap more than independence or neither condition holds.

D5a-37 form B facts (d5f_facts, d5f_lines, d5f_split, d5f_model; d5a37_*.json; read before this line): 141 members, 113 defining, 23 thin, 5 core; verdicts all composes 58, with residue 81, cannot tell 2 (Braveryjerk, wario); defining 43 and 70; all 141 unresolved; n 141, arrow expectations up to 0.800, all not-testable-here; signature Workarounds 0.434 (population 0.249), Backstage decision-making 0.425 (0.228), Repertoire of contention 0.354 (0.172); 1,219 defining lines, 292 restrict lines on arrows; 43 of 113 defining nearer another centre (D 19, A 15, C 6, F 3); split at k 8 into B.1 (88 defining, 107 rooms) and B.2 (25, 34) does not read (B.2 leans to Repertoire of contention, 0.960 against 0.182; B.1 no lean of its own). Mixture rule (d5f_mixture.py > d5a37_mixture.json): holders Workarounds 49 (anchored elements K05, K06, P14), Backstage decision-making 48 (P23, P33), Repertoire of contention 40 (C02, P09, P33); overlaps against independence: W and B 19 (20.8), W and R 18 (17.3), B and R 14 (17.0), all three 7 (7.4); 20 hold none; only one: W 19, B 22, R 15. Tree: first split B.1/B.2: B 43 of 48 in B.1, W 33 of 49 in B.1, R 24 of 40 in B.2; second level: B 35 in B.1.1, W 24 in B.1.2 and 15 in B.2.1, R 17 in B.2.1. The rule's outcome: the overlap condition holds (at about independence; W and R exceed it by 0.7 of a room), the tree condition fails for all three (only R's set is not two thirds in one part, and B and W fall in the same part at the first split), so neither 'stand apart' nor 'mixed' as the rule defined them; the rule did not foresee this case. I report it as three patterns held by different rooms at about chance, which the tree does not sort, with raiding the nearest to a part of its own (B.2: 24 of its 25 defining rooms hold attack calls).

D5a-37 restrict lines on arrows by form B's defining members, read whole and sorted in four pages (d5a37_sort_1 to _4.json; joined by d5f_restricts.py --sort > d5a37_restrict_sorted.json; read before this line): 292 lines; the arrow fails here 135, the record cannot show it 83, both 22, neither 52. Form B's own arrows: A06 (keeping, then scripts) F 11 of 18, B 4, R 2, N 1 (scripts and spare accounts came for building or attack before any strain); A15 (a call, then attack) R 11 of 18, F 3, B 2, N 2 (the record does not show recruited builders turned into attackers); A16 (attack call, then restraint) F 7 of 10 (bare refusals, withdrawal by the proposer); A12 F 12 of 21; A11 F 34 of 56; A10 F 15 of 20; A13 F 10, R 7 of 24; A05 N 10, F 6 of 18.

D5a-37, the parts of the tree below B read for the mixture question (read before this line): B.2 (25 defining) holds attack calls in 24 (only r/unitedkingdom without) and scripts in 14; B.1.1 (54) holds the chat in 35; B.1.2 (34) holds scripts in 24. d5f_split.py gained a --start option (description beyond the walk; the walk from the form is byte-identical to before, d5a37_split_check.json against d5a37_split.json); run from B.1 (d5a37_split_B1.json): B.1's split at k 12 does not read either: B.1.2 leans to Workarounds (2.20 times B.1's share; 0.706 against 0.167) and Negotiated order (1.74; 0.824 against 0.407), B.1.1 has no lean of its own. Reading: the chat, the scripts and raiding are held by different rooms at about chance overlap and fall into different parts of the tree at its second level (raiding B.2, scripts B.1.2, the chat B.1.1, the form's centre), but no split reads by the rule, so they are leans inside B, not subforms; raiding is the clearest. Representatives by rule 5: best r/quebec (0.766; 22 changes; 203 concepts) and r/reddevils (0.799; 22; 236; its point lies nearer D's centre); least r/lofihiphop (1.415; 6; 12; nearer E); read at length r/AmericanFlaginPlace (0.807; 23; 609; not read at length earlier). Models of r/quebec and r/AmericanFlaginPlace read whole; 56 quotes for the four through cite.py (d5a37_cites_reps.txt), 38 for 17 other members (d5a37_cites_more.txt), theme quotes (d5a37_theme_quotes.txt).
